Episodes: new E1325 (the Lebanese push on the Austrian flag and heart, a cedar called a fir tree, and the heart-for-protection treaty, h5.17 to h57.33, four members in both rooms), E1326 (Lebanese hearts beside the French flag, defence offered to France, France's request to move them, French protection read through the mandate and Sykes-Picot), E1327 (the genderfluid flag taken over by Lebanese placers and defended, one member in both rooms), E1328 (a Lebanese flag on part of the Hungarian flag, asked for and permitted), E1329 (a Palestinian flag sought in the flag hearts by one member in both rooms), E1330 (Lebanese flag hearts in the heart rows and r/placehearts' request against bridged or duplicate hearts accepted, five members in both rooms). Not episodes, leads for B1d: mexico (the Mexican petitions to stop defacing its flag, c0094, c0160, c0170, c0171, by a member who writes in r/mexico; r/mexico's record names nothing of Lebanon); israel (Lebanese griefing of the Israeli flag and its retaliation argued in r/lebanon, c0036, c0056, c0057, c0129, c0131, c0177, c0180, c0186; r/israel's record names nothing of Lebanon); czech (a conqueror turning to the Czech heart after the treaty breach, c0192 and c0193; nothing of Lebanon in r/czech's record); ainbowroad (hearts lost to the rainbow road, c0200). Named only: canada, romania, indonesia, poland, denmark, syria, iraq. National content named plainly: calls to steal the Austrian flag and turn the Canadian and Israeli flags Lebanese; a war with the Austrians and a treaty trading a heart for protection; Lebanese members griefing Israel's flag, others refusing a new feud with Israel and pointing to the Israel-Palestine pixel war; French protection called history repeating and Sykes-Picot; a Palestinian member seeking a flag in the hearts; a member rejecting nationality as the explanation for a workplace theft (c0080).
